title: Ek kafela laya tha mein
body:
Ek kafela laya tha mein
Ek kafela laya tha mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Sula hai kabr mai besheer ko husaini ghareeb, Har ek shaheed ke lashe pe aaye hai rote huwe, Labe husain se suye falak aayi sadaa
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Us kafele mein tha ali akber sa ek beta jawaan, Abbas jesa bhayi tha, (Masum asgher be zubaan) x2
Kuch bibiya thi saath mein mehshar mein jinka naam tha
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye kafela kaise luta ye soch ke mai ro diya, Pala tha jinko naaz se, (karbobala mein kho diya), Un sab ke laashe samne the aur hoto par buka
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Karyal jawaan ki laash hatho par uthayi hai abhi, Ek be zuban ki kabr bhi, (Maine banayi hai abhi) x2
Samaan mere katl ka karte hai ab ye ashkiya
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyase mere atfaal hai behta hai darya samne, Ek be watan ko dasht mein, (Luta hai foje shaam ne) x2
Roti hai mere chah ne waalo ke laasho par kazaa
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Kismat meri laykar muje karbobala tak agayi, Ab barte barte bat
(Zainab ki rida tak agayi) x2
Ho jawoonga mein katl to chinjayegi uski rida
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch der mein kanjar laeen ka halk par chal jayenga, Aur baad mere khaym-e
(Sadaat bhi jal jaayenga) x2
Ya yu koi pardes mein aa kar lootaye karbela
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab katl mein ho jawoonga shaame ghariba ayengi, Saydaniyo ke kalb pe, (taaza kayamat dhayengi) x2
us waqt uthengi meri laashe buridaa se sadaa
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
lashe sabhi rehjayengi jalti zamin par bekafan, kaydi banengi mustufa
(ki aal pabandhe rasan) x2
Raho mein rota jayenga bimar ye karke buka
<<MINI>>
(Ek kafela laya tha mein) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Reh jayengi bali sakina ki fugaa zindan mein, Kaydi rahengi saal bhar, (saydaniya zindan mein) x2
sajaad mera kayd se jayenga ye kehte huwa.
